notice.title: Waitrose recalls Waitrose Essential Unsweetened Oat Drink because of poor temperature control
notice.description: Waitrose is recalling Waitrose Essential Unsweetened Oat Drink due to the risk of microbiological contamination and spoilage because there has been a breakdown in temperature control which may make these products unsafe to drink.
notice.consumerAdvice: If you have bought any of the above product, do not eat it. Instead, return it to the store from where it was bought for a full refund.

problem.riskStatement: Waitrose recalls Waitrose Essential Unsweetened Oat Drink due to the risk of microbiological contamination and spoilage.

batchDescription.bestBeforeDescription: All dates between 14 August and 29 October 2026 purchased between 2 September and 21 September 2026
